songs.title: B.O.M.
songs.bio: SAVIONCE's 'B.O.M.' (Black On Me) is a powerful song addressing the injustices, inequality, police brutality, and discrimination against Black Americans. Through poignant lyrics, it delves into the struggles of marginalized individuals. The song portrays three distinct characters, each representing a facet of these challenges. A strong, afro-adorned woman embodies the resilience of Black culture, while a man with long locs confronts stereotypes as 'Medusa.' Lastly, a young girl named Sha’Quadila Keisha, overcoming name-based bullying, symbolizes the strength within unique identities.

artists.name: SAVIONCE
artists.bio: Georgia-based kooky songwriter who creates with a message to deliver. From zany, charismatic story-telling to rapping some serious bars, he is ready for any genre to come his way.

artists.name: London Llaflare
artists.bio: Illinois-based vocalist and rapper London Llaflare dreams of becoming the next breakout artist. To achieve this goal, he continues to flaunt his genius in wordplay, spontaneous yet blunt lyricism, and a vocal style that can set him blazing within any genre.

artists.name: Pio Milano
artists.bio: In Pio Milano's own words, music is an odyssey of experiences. This legendary artist sparked a fire within, illuminating a path where creativity and joy intersected, igniting a lifelong passion for creating music.
